blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Land Transportation Office (LTO) has ordered a 90-day preventive suspension of the driver’s license of a Parañaque City government employee accused of tailgating a female motorist and repeatedly attempting to overtake using the opposite lane. The incident began in Don Bosco and continued to Annex 42 in Parañaque City, according to the LTO. The female motorist alleged that the driver repeatedly honked the horn and flashed the vehicle’s high-beam headlights while following her.
